summary: John's 2nd great-uncle; younger brother of William F. Meier.
bio:
Born 30 Jun 1906 in Tamaqua (fixing the family's Tamaqua years); office clerk at a coal company, living with his parents at 16 Barney St, in 1940 aged 33.

FamilySearch has Joseph's later life ([R4-S1]). After 1940 he married Mary Agatha Lyons, the widow of Joseph Francis Moore, who had died in 1945, so the marriage was after 1945. He lived at Merchantville, New Jersey, by 1957. He died in Philadelphia on 16 Feb 1970 and was buried at St Mary's, Hanover Twp. His wife died in 1999 and was buried there too.
